task: Turn a scanned table or screenshot into an editable Excel spreadsheet
packaging_note: Uses img2table 2.0.0 with local English Tesseract OCR.

inputs.what: a PNG, JPEG or PDF with a printed English table and visible cell borders on each page

outputs.what: an editable worksheet for each table, in page order, with whole-number counts stored as numbers

known_issues: Check the cells against the original before using the numbers. Faint rules, low resolution and merged cells can cause errors. Handwriting and borderless tables are outside this recipe.
